description: Curated subset of the knob_table dataset of the iteration-3 Step 0 evaluation (Qwen/Qwen3-8B writing path-search code; T1 = unweighted grid shortest path, T2 = weighted shortest path). One example = one unit (experiment x task x condition x decoding). `programs` holds the per-program [label, label_fine, passed] records the unit was computed from; the remaining fields are the published knob_table example.
selection: every exp6 unit (temperature x top-k/top-p x thinking grid, context seeds, prompt instructions, forced controls, generate-then-select), the exp1 and exp9 prompt bans (single, TOP, TOP5, ARC, SCATTER) and the exp4 activation-steering rows, each with its reference row

full_table.verdict: Among 108 rankable KNOB rows costing fewer than 20 pass points, none reaches rarefied Hill-1 of 2 at depth 25; the best is exp6 t2 seed_semantic (T1.0|kNone|p1.0|thinkFalse) at 1.940 [90% 1.770, 2.094] for 7.0 pass points; its interval includes 2.
